title: The Most Overlooked Way to Make Money with AI (+10 More Ideas)
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
description:
Check out my newsletter at https://TKOPOD.com and join my new community at https://TKOwners.com

I sat down with Michael Girdley and we pitched back and forth on some creative business ideas and startup ideas. We went all over the place, from a browser plugin that detects AI-generated content, to setting up old-timey photo booths in bars, to building a mosquito death star that literally zaps bugs with lasers.

We also talked about launching foreign-language YouTube channels using AI voice cloning with tools like ElevenLabs, and why now might be the best time to get into content creation. Facebook has over 2.1 billion daily active users and is actively paying creators because they need better videos. That makes it a huge opportunity for facebook monetization, and it's perfect for you, especially if you're trying to make money online, start an internet business, or explore a new side hustle.

On top of that, we got into building a pro-natalist tech fund, and even a fully legal way to take over a county government in Texas. If you're looking for simple business ideas, ways to make passive income, or just love a good business podcast, this one’s for you.

You can find Michael on Twitter at https://x.com/girdley or at https://girdley.com
